name: shared-component-uses-action-button
description: A new shared component follows the shared component rules: it lives in packages/ui and uses ActionButton, not the button primitive.
prompt: Create a reusable EmptyListMessage component that shows a title, a description and an optional action button with a label and a click handler. Applications will use it when a list has no items. Follow the repository rules, then run the lint and type checks for the package you changed.
